A.why: Steam is a real new effect and the black pool reads, but the sinter mound looks like stacked crates and the pool is a flat sheet.

B.best_shot: shots seed 2, along the pressure ridge
B.why: The frozen horse and shield in the pale pans are a good idea, but the ridge never reads as long sails and the scene is cluttered.

C.best_shot: shots seed 1, the span from the near bank
C.why: The rope-and-timber bridge over a stepped dark cut is real geometry with height. The crack is shallow and the seeds are near-identical.

D.why: Stepped shaft plus a strong aurora column is something the game lacks and it reads from the game camera, but all three seeds are the same bowl.

E.best_shot: shots seed 1, the standard and the shield wall
E.why: The ranks of spears read as armies from above. The standard is a plain pillar, the mist is faint, and the road shots are blocked.

F.why: The fluted tongue reads only from the top. Every close shot is a dark mass with no lit subject, and the drip is barely visible.

G.why: The spindrift effect is good, but the ridges read as murky stepped terraces and the shots have no subject.

H.best_shot: shots seed 1, the giant's court from above
H.why: A strong ring layout round a lit pool, but the giants read as shrines, not kneeling bodies, and the snowfall is lost at distance.

I.best_shot: shots seed 1, the great barrow's door
I.why: The lit threshold and wisps are a clear point of interest, but the mounds don't read as barrows and the frames are murky.

J.best_shot: shots seed 1, the ship in the ice
J.why: A tilted longship with mast and ribs out of the ice has the best silhouette and photograph of the run. The hull glow is a vague smear and the seeds repeat.

notes: J and D tie on total; J ranks first for the better photograph, D has the stronger effect and reads best from the game camera. Across the board the seeds are weak: most features repeat one layout three times. Close shots are mostly too dark to have a subject. The features whose effect is their idea (A, D, G) only show it in the set-piece panel.
